dedupe_keys.name: intertubes us long haul fibre optic infrastructure topology impact ds 0521

description: This IMPACT dataset holds the materials behind the paper 'InterTubes: A Study of the US Long-haul Fiber-optic Infrastructure' (ACM SIGCOMM 2015) by Durairajan and colleagues. Contents: an image of the map of US long-haul infrastructure, a list of nodes, a list of links and a connectivity matrix, in an archive of 488.3 KB; the record is categorised as infrastructure data on internet physical infrastructure, collected between 1 October 2014 and 18 February 2015, not anonymised, and not an ongoing measurement. Producer: the University of Wisconsin, hosted by IMPACT (DOI 10.23721/110/1354028). Coverage: long-haul fibre routes across the continental United States. Access: requires a free IMPACT account and a request for access; the restriction type is listed as unrestricted. Licence and cost: free, with commercial use marked unknown in the data use terms. Caveats: a 2014 to 2015 snapshot compiled from public records and mapped conduit sharing, so routes and providers have since changed. Simulation uses: the topology supports long-haul resilience, shared-risk and cascading-failure analysis of US Internet backbone links. Related record: the CAIDA IXPs dataset (data-caida-ixps-dataset).
